correction.explicit_reload: Restarts both readers and reauthorizes their data before republication.
correction.global_failures_preserved: 401, 403, 409 and every other non-503 read failure retain the global failure path. All mutation/export/attachment failures retain global invalidation, including 503. Account/access, investigation/conversation/run navigation and context changes retain their existing cancellation/clearing fences.
correction.history_503_or_timeout: Dispose the history scheduler, increment its poll epoch, clear cached/history/discovery/receipt-list values and answer-policy state, and show its own error. Do not change the global epoch, cancel the receipt scheduler, clear the verified receipt/page or clear its policy proof.
correction.receipt_503_or_timeout: Dispose only the receipt scheduler and clear opened/page/receipt-policy state; show its own error without erasing separately verified history.

failure_reproduction.baseline_test_definition: Initial nine-case version of the new regression harness; expanded to fifteen cases after the baseline run. The baseline log is retained by hash; its test-file bytes were not separately archived.
failure_reproduction.cause: Answer-history hydration and retained-receipt open/page had independent schedulers but shared global error/epoch invalidation, so an unavailable history read erased a separately verified receipt and stopped its polling.
